fish-ibi-lakes.geojson.caveats: DNR lake fish IBI (Index of Biological Integrity) scores. Research verification (synthesis §1.4, 20 Nov 2026) said '111 lakes'. CORRECTION: the live returnCountOnly count is 111, but the unit is SURVEY ROWS, not lakes -- this pull holds 111 features across 46 distinct lakes (1-8 surveys per lake, survey years 2005-2024); sibling rows for one lake share identical geometry. The synthesis '111 lakes' figure is therefore wrong as a lake count; the row count matches the live service exactly. CONFIRMED: Leech Lake itself (DOW 11020300) is NOT in this service (direct query dow='11020300' returns 0 rows) -- large lakes are assessed under the Large Lake Program, not the small-lake FIBI. ibi_score is the fish-community score; status is vs the impairment threshold; num_*/prop_* fields are species-count metrics (raw and standardised).
